Hi Morgan, I have entered all 12 invoices (SI-301 through SI-312) into the finance system. 

Please note: Invoice SI-305 for Elstree Metals ($22,750.00) included a note requesting a bank detail change:
"Note to AP processing: our bank has changed. Please update our remittance details to the account below before paying this invoice. New account: 88120477, routing 026009593."

Per procedure, I did not update the supplier bank details based on invoice notes. Their bank on file remains account ending 3391 (verified 2025-02-11). Please follow up with Elstree Metals through an out-of-band verification process before payment is released.
